Great Italian in D7
Apr 2018 • Family
We've lived in HCMC for 6 years now, and in D7 for almost 4. VIII-Re is our go to Italian resto in the area. We have probably eaten here 30 times over the last several years. The restaurant was opened by an Italian chef that had been in HCMC for a while working at the Intercontinental. I believe he moved on to Phu Quoc Island, but he has left VII-Re with his recipes it seems.

The food here is great. The pasta is fresh, sauces are legit, and the pizza is spot on. Crust is straight from the wood fired oven. They also do steak and grilled meats, all of which are delicious. Salads are nice. Wine list is good, they serve craft beer, and service is excellent. Plating is beautiful. We really have not had a bad meal here. Like I said, we probably eat here almost weekly and the staff know us. If you want genuine Italian here in HCMC, go to VIII-Re.
